CosmicEnvironment.description: An Environment resource representing a per-ring deployment environment within a namespace.

properties.description: The resource-specific properties for this resource.

platformRing.description: Platform ring classification (e.g. test, sdf, msit, prod).

topology.description: Topology configuration including per-location networking and partition declarations.

resourcePolicy.description: Resource policy configuration for the environment.

isolationGroup.description: Isolation group override for cluster bin-packing affinity. When set, all NamespaceInstances in this environment are placed on this isolation group instead of the parent namespace's isolationGroup. Useful when different environments of the same namespace (e.g. dev vs prod) should target different clusters. Cannot be changed after environment creation.

provisioningState.description: The provisioning state of the environment resource.

CosmicProvisioningState.description: The provisioning state of a Cosmic resource.

values.name: Accepted
values.description: The resource creation request has been accepted.

DeletedEnvironment.description: A soft-deleted Environment, surfaced as a read-only tombstone under its parent namespace. Lists, restores, and purges are performed against this proxy resource while the namespace remains live.

properties.description: The resource-specific properties for this resource.

DeletedEnvironmentActionRequest.description: Request body for the soft-deleted environment actions (purge, restore), carrying the platform ring so APIM can route the request to the target ring's RP instance. The soft-deleted environment is a proxy resource (not cached by ARM/MetaRP), so the ring is supplied explicitly rather than read from a replayed body.

platformRing.description: Platform ring classification (e.g. test, sdf, msit, prod). Used by APIM to route the request to the target ring's RP instance.

DeletedEnvironmentDeleteMetadata.description: Soft-delete metadata for a deleted environment. All properties are read-only and owned by the resource provider.

deletedAt.description: UTC instant at which the environment was soft-deleted.

purgeAfter.description: UTC instant at which the soft-deleted environment is eligible for automatic purge (deletedAt + retentionPeriod).

retentionPeriod.description: Retention bucket applied to this soft-deleted environment (ISO 8601 duration, e.g. P30DT0H0M).

purgeProtection.description: When true, the environment cannot be manually purged during the retention window.

deletedBy.description: Identity that initiated the delete (non-sensitive context only).

DeletedEnvironmentListResult.description: The response of a DeletedEnvironment list operation.

value.description: The DeletedEnvironment items on this page

nextLink.description: The link to the next page of items

DeletedEnvironmentProperties.description: Properties of a soft-deleted environment. All properties are read-only; the soft-delete state is owned by the resource provider.

deleteMetadata.description: Soft-delete bookkeeping (when it was deleted, retention, purge eligibility, who deleted it).

environment.description: The captured environment configuration at soft-delete time. Mirrors the original resource's properties so a GET on the deleted environment surfaces the full typed body (Key Vault DeletedKeyBundle style).

DeletedEnvironmentPurgeResult.description: Response body for the purge action.

environmentName.description: The name of the environment that was purged.

purged.description: Whether the purge succeeded for all instances of the environment.

reason.description: Failure detail when the purge did not fully succeed (no secrets). Null on success.

DeletedEnvironmentRestoreResult.description: Response body for the restore action.

environmentName.description: The name of the environment that was restored.

restored.description: Whether the restore succeeded for all instances of the environment.

reason.description: Failure detail when the restore did not fully succeed (no secrets). Null on success.
